input.name: Claude 图片链接
input.prompt:
Implement workstream A of /workspace/agents/scratchpad/links/plan.md (Claude provider: prompt image links). Read the plan's Goal, Shared representation and section A, and agents/AGENTS.md.

Rules:
- Other workstreams (Codex provider, UI) edit this same worktree and branch concurrently. Never revert or reformat edits you didn't make; touch only agents/src/providers/claude/** (plus its test fixtures under agents/tests/fixtures if needed). If you need a change elsewhere (e.g. src/log.rs, src/model.rs), stop and ask me via ask_claude instead of editing.
- Each bugfix: failing test first, fixture cut from a real record in ~/.claude/projects (redact base64 to a few bytes), then the fix. No tests of mocked behavior.
- Gate: in agents/, `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets` clean for your code. If a test outside your paths is red because another workstream is mid-edit, note it and don't touch it.
- Commit only your own paths with `git add -- <paths>`, message style `agents: <what>`; commit after each coherent step. Do not push.
- Time limit ~25 minutes. Reply with: commits made, what each image source maps to (the evidence for label↔path pairing), and the answer to plan item A3.
